author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam dives into this incredible 1/18 scale recreation of the filming set of the USS Enterprise's Bridge from Star Trek The Original Series! Factory Entertainment brings us their prototype of this dynamic miniature, which is not only built with lights and active displays surrounding every station, but is made to be modular to recreate the various filming configurations of the actual set. 

Find Factory Entertainment's Star Trek props: https://factoryent.com/collections/star-trek

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
